definitions: A rough, unrefined drawing of a circular shape, created by hand without the aid of instruments.
An informal, quickly rendered depiction of a circle, often used for conceptualization or as a preliminary design element.
examples: The architect started with a hand-drawn circle sketch for the new building's dome.
She quickly made a hand-drawn circle sketch to illustrate her idea.
The whiteboard was covered in hand-drawn circle sketches during the brainstorming session.
